date_note: TechCrunch (published 2026-11-25) says the outage has lasted since Monday morning; Monday was 23 November.
title: Allstate website and app outage since Monday blocks customers from accounts, claims and payments, TechCrunch reports
geo_basis: country: TechCrunch says customers nationwide are affected; no city stated
summary: TechCrunch reports that Allstate has had a tech outage since Monday morning that stops customers nationwide from reaching accounts, policy information, claims and bill payments on its website and mobile app. A message on Allstate's website says services are not available and it is working to restore access. TechCrunch says Allstate has not stated a cause or a restoration time and did not immediately respond to its request for comment.
plain: TechCrunch reports Allstate customers across the US have been unable to use its website and app since Monday. Allstate says it is working to restore access and has not given a cause.
exec: TechCrunch reports a multi-day Allstate outage blocking claims, policy access and payments; no cause has been stated.

validation.note: One publisher (TechCrunch); Allstate's own site message is relayed, not read.

review.note: Outage, scope, no cause, no response checked against TechCrunch
